author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Docker host (Dockerfile + .dockerignore + healthcheck + compose)
description: Emits a maintained Dockerfile + .dockerignore + healthcheck.sh + compose.yml at the solution root. Multi-stage F# build, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK against /health, signal forwarding via tini. One image runs every ServerConfig.ProcessProfile (Phase 16a) — pick the role at boot via TOOLUP_PROCESS_PROFILE.

server-project.description: Server project directory name under src/, e.g. 'MyApp-Server'. The Dockerfile invokes 'dotnet publish src/<server-project>/<server-project>.fsproj' in the build stage.

server-dll.description: Server assembly name (without the .dll extension), e.g. 'MyApp-Server'. The runtime stage's ENTRYPOINT execs 'dotnet <server-dll>.dll'.

image-name.description: Container image name (lowercase, no namespace prefix), e.g. 'myapp'. Used as the compose service image tag and container name.

host-port.description: Host-side port the compose service publishes (container-side is always 5000, matching ServerConfig.Port default).

notification-channel.description: INotificationChannel substrate. 'redis' uncomments the Redis service in compose.yml and adds the depends_on entry on the app service. 'none' (default) leaves Redis commented out.

manualInstructions.text: When deploying behind a reverse proxy, do NOT set TOOLUP_TRUST_FORWARDED_HEADERS — Phase 16d made trust the SDK default. Set =0 only to opt out.
WorkerOnly / DispatcherOnly: pin ReplicaCount = 1 until Phase 9i (IDistributedLock) ships, otherwise scheduler ticks duplicate-fire across replicas.
